home.howTitle: How to take a passport photo at home
home.howSub: Use these handy tips and take a perfect ID or visa photo with your phone — no studio required.
doList: Take a good quality selfie in well-lit room near a window
Keep a neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and visible
dontList: Cast shadows on the face or use light from above/side
Wear headwear (except religious or medical reasons)
Wear glasses unless the document allows them
home.babyBadTitle: Photos that will not be accepted

babyBad: Other people visible in the photo
Non-neutral expression or eyes not visible
Extraneous objects (toys, etc.) in the frame

about.title: About PhotoGov
about.p1: PhotoGov is a free online tool that helps travelers create compliant passport, visa and ID photos without a photo studio. We replicate the document standards published by government agencies in 190+ countries and let you crop, adjust and export a print-ready photo in seconds.
about.p2: Official photo rules are confusing and change often. Our goal is to make a compliant photo accessible to everyone — on any device, in any country, for free.
about.p3: Your photos are processed entirely in your browser. We do not upload or store them on our servers. Read our {privacy}.
about.note: This is an unofficial demo clone of www.photogov.net, built for educational and replication purposes. Not affiliated with any government agency.

compliance.title: How we stay compliant
compliance.sub: Every photo template follows the exact size, background, head-size and resolution rules published by passport and visa authorities.
compliance.sizesText: We encode each document's official dimensions in millimetres, inches and pixels, and export at the required DPI (typically 300) for crisp prints.
compliance.headText: The editor guides head height and eye level so your photo matches the authority's acceptance criteria.
compliance.bgText: One-click white or light-blue backgrounds meet the most common requirements. AI background removal helps when the original background isn't plain.
compliance.note: Always double-check the latest rules on the official authority website linked on each document page before submitting.

legal.secPhotosText: All image processing happens locally in your browser using the Canvas API. Your photos are never uploaded to our servers.
legal.secAnalyticsText: We use privacy-friendly, aggregated analytics to understand usage. No personally identifiable information is collected from your photos.
legal.secCookiesText: We use a minimal cookie to remember your preferences (such as country and cookie consent). See our {cookie}.
legal.useText: PhotoGov provides photo-cropping and formatting tools for informational and personal use. We do not guarantee acceptance by any government authority.
legal.warrantyText: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. You are responsible for verifying that your photo meets current official requirements.
legal.liabilityText: We are not liable for any rejection of a photo or any consequential loss.
legal.changesText: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
legal.cookieWhatText: We use a small number of cookies to remember your selected country and your cookie-consent choice. These are strictly functional.
legal.cookieAnalyticsText: Aggregated, anonymized analytics help us improve the tool. No photo data is involved.
legal.cookieManageText: You can clear cookies in your browser settings at any time.
